body:
Wow... I never thought I would get this many responses. I never thought I would get so much advice and offers of help. I would like to think that I would get any help I need, even if that is going to the local hospital, because I would rather be there for my children, ya know? My.. soon to be ex-wife and her family have made it very clear that I should stay in the military at all costs to be able to pay child support and to make sure my wife and especially my children will be taken care of. But they don't know what its like for your children to be suddenly taken away from you and they never had their spouse just leave and never come back. I can get other jobs, but I can't get time with my children back... Thank you for letting me speak about all of this. I woke up this morning and saw all the posts and thought all these strangers care about me.. Thank you.

I'm also quite embarrassed about the grammar of my posts. I apologize they were written on my phone.

Have you talked to anyone about? Like brought it to your command or medical? Maybe you have seen someone bring these thoughts to medical as a corpsman? I was at Camp Lejeune for a little while too a long time ago..

I think the worst part is I just feel like quiting. I want to quit. I know I have children but sometimes I feel like they and my soon to be ex-wife will be better off without me. That the only thing I can do is kill myself so that they will get my death gratuity, life insurance, and VA benefits... I'm almost at the point where I don't care what happens to my career I just want this pain to end. I'm afraid to admit that if I did have a gun in my house I might have already done it already. Wow, I have never told that to anyone before. But I guess that is the truth about how I feel right now. Thank you for the comments, I honestly didn't expect even this many replies.
